retrievalProfile.description: A warm, monochromatic red studio portrait featuring a subject interacting with percussion instruments and fluid, hand-drawn yellow script.
excludeWhen: a cold or blue color palette is requested
a busy outdoor environment is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure reclining across three conga drums against a seamless, saturated red background, accompanied by a stylized yellow graphic emblem and fluid script in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject reclining horizontally across vertical drum pillars
High-contrast yellow graphic elements against a deep red field
Warm studio lighting creating soft gradients on skin and instruments
Triangular composition formed by the three drums and the subject's torso
coreInvariants: Three conga drums as the primary furniture/props
Fluid, hand-drawn yellow script and icon

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, reclining horizontally across the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The three conga drums provide a stable, rhythmic base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face, down the reclining body to the drums, then up to the bright yellow script in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of saturated red space surround the central elements, focusing attention on the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black (drums and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red with deep shadows on the drums and soft highlights on the skin.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, cursive script with varying line weights
letterConstructionRules: Hand-drawn, organic feel with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' has a long horizontal bar that flows into the next letters
The final character ends in a long, sweeping underline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the fluid script with a small, high-contrast blocky sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn floral/fruit icon above the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, hand-drawn feel of the original.
Captures the informal and artistic nature of the text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person reclining across three conga drums against a seamless, saturated red background with warm lighting and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a hand-drawn yellow script and a small floral icon in the top right corner using a fluid, organic style.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated, monochromatic red?
Are there three conga drums supporting the subject?
Is the typography yellow and fluidly hand-drawn?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of three drums
Ensure the yellow script is fluid and legible
Confirm the film grain texture is subtle but present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a monochromatic studio backdrop with a subject interacting with rhythmic props, accented by high-contrast, hand-drawn graphic elements.
